parameters.name: FunctionType
parameters.description:
The function type. Valid values:

- encode_pic: adds an image watermark by using the legacy model.

- encode_pic_plus: adds an image watermark by using the new model 1.

- encode_pic_bold: adds an image watermark by using the new model 2.

- decode_pic: decodes the image watermark from an image by using the legacy model. This corresponds to the encode_pic watermark method.

- decode_pic_plus: decodes the image watermark from an image by using the new model 1. This corresponds to the encode_pic_plus watermark method.

- decode_pic_bold: decodes the image watermark from an image by using the new model 2. This corresponds to the encode_pic_bold watermark method.

parameters.name: LogoURL
parameters.description:
The URL of the watermark image to be added. We recommend that you use an OSS URL in the China (Shanghai) region. If the file is stored locally or in an OSS bucket outside the China (Shanghai) region, see [File URL processing](~~155645~~).

>- This parameter is required when FunctionType is set to `encode_pic`, `encode_pic_plus`, or `encode_pic_bold`.
- Do not set this parameter when FunctionType is set to `decode_pic`, `decode_pic_plus`, or `decode_pic_bold`.

parameters.name: OriginImageURL
parameters.description:
The URL of the original image. We recommend that you use an OSS URL in the China (Shanghai) region. If the file is stored locally or in an OSS bucket outside the China (Shanghai) region, see [File URL processing](~~155645~~).
>- This parameter is required when FunctionType is set to `encode_pic`, `encode_pic_plus`, `encode_pic_bold`, or `decode_pic`.
- Do not set this parameter when FunctionType is set to `decode_pic_plus` or `decode_pic_bold`.

parameters.name: OutputFileType
parameters.description:
The format of the output image. Valid values: `jpeg`, `png`, `jpg`, and `bmp`. Default value: `png`.
>- This parameter is required when FunctionType is set to `encode_pic`, `encode_pic_plus`, or `encode_pic_bold`.
- Do not set this parameter when FunctionType is set to `decode_pic`, `decode_pic_plus`, or `decode_pic_bold`.

parameters.name: QualityFactor
parameters.description:
The quality of the output image. A larger value indicates higher quality. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 100.
>This parameter takes effect only when OutputFileType is set to `jpg`.

parameters.name: WatermarkImageURL
parameters.description:
The URL of the image to be decoded, which is the composite image that contains the image watermark. We recommend that you use an OSS URL in the China (Shanghai) region. If the file is stored locally or in an OSS bucket outside the China (Shanghai) region, see [File URL processing](~~155645~~).
>- This parameter is required when FunctionType is set to `decode_pic`, `decode_pic_plus`, or `decode_pic_bold`.
- Do not set this parameter when FunctionType is set to `encode_pic`, `encode_pic_plus`, or `encode_pic_bold`.
